reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Really good infrastructure and facilities. Faculty was great.

review_content.Placements: The college provided internships to every student. A year of internship was mandatory.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college had centrally air-conditioned classrooms with Wi-Fi-enabled LCD projectors, well-equipped labs, a library, and an auditorium. The college had renovated hostels, a gymnasium, a sports complex, and a playground. The hostel rooms were great and fully furnished with attached washrooms. The hostel had an attached lawn within its premises. It also had its mess, and the food quality was great.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers were really helpful and highly qualified. They made learning interesting and easy. There was no semester system. Final exams were conducted annually. 50% was required to pass the exams. The difficulty level of the exams was moderate. There were about 100 seats available every year. The admission process was done on the basis of the NEET UG entrance exam. BDS and MS courses were there. The fee structure was about 5 LPA.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: The college is very nice and is very near to the city and has a good patient scale.

review_content.Placements: As such, there are no package of food in our course and one hundred percent of the students got internship from our college, and the internship is done here in the college only. Students securing more than 75% in 12th grade are given admission here after clearing the NEET exam.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is amazing and it’s surrounded by plants. The lecture theatres are nicely air-conditioned. The departments are very airy and large and have ample space for many patient tackling. The departments are nicely equipped to meet the needs of treatment.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the faculty and the services they provide.

review_content.Placements: Being a dental college, placements are great in the area of dentistry. People opt for foreign courses or private practice. An internship is compulsory for the course and is completed at the college itself. Some people also choose to do a master's after BDS.
review_content.Infrastructure: Well-furnished labs and departments are there. A fully equipped library with the latest editions of books and foreign authors is also available. Lush green campus with all other amenities like a canteen and sports complex, which also has a gym. Hostels are well furnished and maintained.

reviews_list.review_title: Review of Luxmi Bai Institute of Dental Sciences and Hospital.

reviews_list.review_title: This college provides good infrastructure and it well maintained.

review_content.Placements: I am studying in a dental college, and medical colleges do not provide me with placements. You can either open your own clinic, gain experience at someone else clinic or continue to study further if you are planning to do MS, but we do not get placed in companies.

review_summary.college_name: Pt. Dr. Shiv Shaktilal Sharma Ayurved Medical College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: BAMS - Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: It is a great college with a great environment and infrastructure.

content.Placements: I have started studying B.A.M.S from SAM College Ratlam in 2017. They provide a great environment. About 70% of students get placements from there. Many of them work in college also after completion of MD courses. They offer every course in B.A.M.S for higher studies.
content.Infrastructure: The boys and girls hostel is situated at Katju Nagar with an annual fee of Rs. 24,000 and mess fee of Rs. 52,000. Our college is situated near MBBS college Banjali. Our SAM college has a great infrastructure with labs and also a playground and canteen as well. It is great about this college.

individual_reviews.course: BAMS - Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is absolutely fine to study here, and it has good practices of clinical and faculty members.

content.Placements: Almost 100% of the students get placed every year from a batch from our college. There are good placements, and our college has its own hospital for internships.
content.Infrastructure: There are huge classrooms here, and they have projectors for defined study. The education is of co-education type, and there are all the labs which are needed for practical study. The infrastructure in the hostel is quite good, and the hostel has separate rooms for a small group of students with electricity and water facility all the time. Hostel rooms have their own privacy, and they contain study tables, beds and a storage compartment for every student.

individual_reviews.course: BAMS - Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Good campus life with a great college.

content.Placements: The amount of students which are selected in our college placements depends upon their knowledge. The highest-paid package was Rs.20 Lacs per annum. Top role in B.A.M.S. is of an Ayurvedic doctor.
content.Infrastructure: Truly, the infrastructure of our college is so good, even no private college in Madhya Pradesh offer this kind of environment and infrastructure that our college has. There's a big library and many sports areas as well. They also offer digital classrooms with projectors.
content.Faculty: The Faculty present here are the doctor which are selected from different states like Rajasthan and more. The exams are quite tough but if you study by taking advices from seniors of the college then it is perfect and you can score easily. Also, the faculty members try to help the students in every possible way.

individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the crowd, good placement, and good infrastructure and facilities

content.Placements: 50% of students got placed from our course. Depending upon where you are placed, I think in Kerala, the highest starting salary is Rs. 20,000. Apollo is one of the recruiting companies for this course. 99 percent of students got internships, I guess. Clinical pharmacist is the top role offered in this course.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, labs, classrooms, library, and even a digital library are also available. I think the facilities are really good, the food is also very tasty, and they change the menu every month, and there is a mess meeting also. Medical facilities are also provided. There are various games and sports we can engage in at our hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: College is good, you can enjoy college life and study at the same time.

content.Placements: Overall placement rate for undergraduate students is 85%. The average salary for B.Pharma graduates is 2.23 LPA. Top recruiting companies in Kerala include Sun Pharma, Ramco, and others. About 85% of students get an internship from the course and the college. After finishing the course, graduates can become a drug inspector, among other roles.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel at Al Shifa College of Pharmacy is very good. They provide good quality food with different meals every day. The rooms are good, very clean, and neat, with a lot of space. There are also good bathrooms and washrooms. The hostel has a medical room for its own use.

individual_reviews.course: Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Al shifa offering top notch facilities and educational opportunities.

content.Placements: Al shifa college of pharmacy offers top placement opportunities. Al shifa has a placement cell that has connections to some of the top companies currently in the pharmaceutical industry field. Every year the final years of every course gets the opportunity to display their skills and knowledge in a campus placement drive a majority of the students do get campus placement with a good salary package ranging anywhere from. 7-12 Lacs. Some of the major roles offered by my course are clinical pharmacist, pharmacovigilance offices etc. Pharma.D students also get 1 year of mandatory internship at their 6 year.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The placements are not so good but it is good for pursuing Bachelors.

content.Placements: The salary offered is between 10K to 20K per month. Students are placed in hospital during internship on the basis of how much knowledge we have about the treatment. The salary in the beginning is less but with experience it increases. Post the course, students can even open their own clinic or even hospital or work privately too. But since the salary is very low, I am opting for M.Pharma.
content.Infrastructure: Several fests are conducted all round the year. The library is just awesome, they have tons of referral books in the library. We have a hostel, which I would rate 8/10. Facilities and maintenance are good. Regular cleaning of washrooms and good furniture is also there.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Our college is very good, and facilities, infrastructure and all things are also very good.

content.Placements: The highest salary package offered is 8 LPA in a degree course. Companies that make drugs are the recruiters for B.Pharma degree holders. B.Pharma degree holders can become analyst, pharmacist and medical director. There are also many other opportunities. It is a good and satisfactory degree.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is the best. In the hostel, there are refrigerators and other suitable things, which made everything very good.
content.Faculty: The teaching quality is very good, and they taught us in the English language too. They are taking care of us like their own children, and they are very helpful and give more respect.

The college offers various courses in Engineering, Management, Commerce, and Pharmacy among others. The university includes BTech, BCom, MTech, etc. Seacom Skills University is accepting application forms for all its courses via online and offline modes. Seacom Skills Universityadmission procedure has a multi-step process, which has to be fulfilled by the candidates to get admission. It starts with the application, candidates are required to apply and appear for the respective entrance exam and counselling for the BTech course. Additionally, candidates are required to fill out the eligibility criteria to get direct admission to the courses. Find below theSeacom Skills Universityadmission process 2025:

Additionaly, candidates are also required to register themselves by visiting the official website of college or visit the university campus in person.

After applying for the entrance exam accepted by the university for admission to BTech , students are required to appear for the same to fill out the selection criteria for admission. Additionally, for other courses, candidates are required to fill out the basic eligibility criteria which include that UG candidates must pass Class 10 and Class 12 and PG candidates must have a graduation degree from a recognised institute or university.

Step 4: Admission Confirmation

After the final round, the university releases the merit list based on the counselling round. The candidates who get shortlisted in the counselling round are required to submit the admission fee to lock in the final seat. If the candidate doesn’t paySeacom Skills Universityfeeby the stipulated date, the admission will be deemed cancelled.

college_info.college_name: Seacom Skills University Scholarship Details

paragraphs: Seacom Skills University - SSU provides a variety of Undergrad courses.

The fee structure of Seacom Skills University in 2023-2024 is INR 25,000/ for School Of Commerce And Management Studies (Semester Fees).The fees of School Of Pharmacy is around INR 60,000/ (Semester Fees). As the fees structures are medium to high at Seacom Skills University so their Placements are also good for the candidates who took admission in this University. The highest salary package offered by the University is 3 to 3.5 LPA. and the lowest salary package offered by the various companies is 2 to 2.5 LPA. Altough these packages are according to the courses that done by the students.

Seacom Skills University does not refund fee at all as fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. This is the college policy. It includes Admission fee of Rs 10 thousand as well as semester fee.
The total semester fee is 36000*6 and Rs 10000 one time admission. It also charges 1000 Rs exam fee.

Scholarships including 100%, 50%, and 25% are offered by Seacom Skills University (SSU) in Birbhum, India. Students can also apply for scholarships from state and federal governments. For example, students enrolling in undergraduate courses like UG-Science and other professional degrees approved by the UGC must have obtained at least 75% on their most recent qualifying test in order to be eligible for a scholarship worth INR 1,500.  There are over a dozen distinct types of scholarships available at SSU. These kinds of scholarship programs directly aid a large number of SSU students, especially those from economically poor homes or those with physical limitations.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: MSMIA is the best Ayurvedic college in Haryana. I am absolutely satisfied with the college.

review_content.Placements: The college provides an internship of one year, 6 months in the college hospital, and 6 months in any civil hospital in big cities. Interns are provided with a stipend of Rs. 10,000 per month for the whole year. Students are recruited as Ayurvedic medical officers in civil hospitals.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college provides all the essential facilities of labs, classrooms, and the library to students. All the curriculum books are available in the library and students can issue them anytime they want to. The hostel provides 4 shared rooms, and the food is quite healthy. For medical facilities, the college has its own hospital and PG is also here. Sports like football, volleyball, and badminton are played in the sports complex of the college.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Supporting teacher and warden provide good facilities.

review_content.Placements: 100% placement occurs every year, and the highest package is 4-5 LPA. Companies like Mahindra, Airtel, and many more come to provide internships every semester. The company workshops are well-organized, and students manage all the work during the workshops. The teachers are very helpful.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is good infrastructure providing quality facilities, and all other basic needs are fulfilled. The campus is large, with a good environment and greenery all around. Good medical facilities are available, exams are held regularly, and results are declared quickly. Support for students is also excellent.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: MSM Institute of Ayurveda.

review_content.Placements: This is a decent medical course which offers vast career opportunities. Like you can start your own clinic, go into the research field, do jobs, run your own business, do post-graduation, etc. Top companies like Himalaya Drug Company, Patanjali, Aimil, etc., and even the Ministry of AYUSH.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college and facilities provided are just okay. Classrooms are fully smart. The library contains all books required. The hostel building is also just okay. For sports-loving students, a sports complex is there, and tournaments are also conducted.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: The first women-only university in North India.

review_content.Placements: They say that the university has good placement, with an average of 3 LPA and a maximum salary package of 10 LPA for students. We will experience this later, but this is what we have heard from PAT alumni and our faculty staff. Additionally, there is a placement officer who conveyed the same information.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the overall university campus, including hostels and other areas, is very good. It's just that the campus is quite extensive, making it challenging to traverse from one place to another with a long-distance walk. Therefore, there should be some alternatives.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: My placements from BPMVS.

review_content.Placements: In our college, every year, 60–70% of students get placed through the on-campus placements drive. The placement cell of the college is very active and efficient for placements. The highest package for our course was 13 LPA. The average package at our college is 4-6 LPA. The top roles offered in the course are software developers, web developers, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: In terms of facilities, our college is top-notch. The infrastructure is good and well maintained. The college has necessary facilities like labs, library, canteens, hostels, medical equipment, sports equipments, Wi-Fi, etc. The computer labs have been developed and are working properly. The hostel rooms are furnished and big. The food in the mess is repetitive but good in taste.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with education system.

review_content.Placements: 100 percent placements is done in my college. The highest package is four to five LPA. Students do internships from Hindustan co-operative limited, etc. We start internship in the third year. We earn ten thousand per month. All courses are available in our college.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our university provides all types of facilities like good classroom, labs and library. Hostels are well-maintained, providing good quality of food, and good services. Our university have a friendly environment and it focuses on student's health. Our university PGI is famous in India.

reviews.review_heading: MSMIA is the best Ayurvedic college in Haryana. I am absolutely satisfied with the college.

reviews.review_heading: Supporting teacher and warden provide good facilities.

reviews.review_heading: MSM Institute of Ayurveda.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college and facilities provided are just okay. Classrooms are fully smart. The library contains all books required. The hostel building is also just okay. For sports-loving students, a sports complex is there, and tournaments are also conducted.

reviews.review_heading: The first women-only university in North India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the overall university campus, including hostels and other areas, is very good. reviews.review_heading: My placements from BPMVS.

The hostel rooms are furnished and big. The food in the mess is repetitive but good in taste.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with education system.
reviews.review_text: Our university provides all types of facilities like good classroom, labs and library. Hostels are well-maintained, providing good quality of food, and good services. Our university have a friendly environment and it focuses on student's health. Our university PGI is famous in India.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides great learning experience in Ayurveda.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average. Classrooms are not air-conditioned. There is a smart board in each classroom. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of faculty. Good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure, the college has centrally air conditioned classrooms with Wi-Fi enabled LCD, projectors, tutorial rooms, a library, seminar room and a fully equipped auditorium with seating capacity over 800 persons. The college is endowed with renovated hostels, medical support system, modern gymnasium, a huge parking facility, air conditioned sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of excellent infrastructure, facilities, supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure, The college has centrally air conditioned classrooms with Wi-fi enabled LCD projectors, tutorial rooms, a library, a state-of-the-art seminar room and a fully equipped auditorium with seating capacity of over 750 persons. The college is endowed with renovated hostels, medical support systems (along with physiotherapy centre), modern gymnasium, a huge parking facility (available to both students and faculty), air conditioned sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college because it is average.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for the computer science and engineering department are good. The food is not good in our hostel. Insects can be found in our food. Sports and game facilities are average in our department. The canteen is the best in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the education system in this university.
reviews.review_text: Almost all the facilities are provided in university. Like labs, Wi-Fi,  24/7 Library and other co-curricular departments. Hostel are well organised. Good quality of food is served and 24/7 medical services are provided to students. A separate physical department is there for all the sports and games activities.

reviews.review_heading: It is an average college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and Wi-Fi facilities are good, but the food is not tasty. There is no medical facility on campus. If anyone is sick, she or he has to go to the hospital with the warden. The hospital is 2-3 km away from the campus. Our institute owns the hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Bhagat Phool Singh Mahila Vishwavidyalaya.
reviews.review_text: Labs are available in our college. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. Hostels are well-built. The hostel does not provide a variety of food items. The food served in the hostel is not tasty. We eat in the canteen or outside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is better. Buildings are not very old, and maintenance is done timely. Wi-Fi is available on our campus, but the network is not good.

reviews.review_heading: There are few coding subjects in our college.
reviews.review_text: We have multiple laboratories in our college. Wi-Fi is also very good. The hostels are better. In each hostel room, two students can stay easily. All facilities are available in hostel rooms. There are 2 libraries on our campus, and several books are available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. All departments have their own building. Labs are there. AC classrooms are available. For self-study, there is a library where students can study peacefully. Sports and games are available. Medical facilities are also there. Mess food is healthy and totally clean. Canteen is also here. The infrastructure of DAV University is so beautiful and good.

reviews.review_heading: My experience in DAV University .
reviews.review_text: I don't use hostel facilities, but my friends told me about the food that the food is not much good, not bad. Here, Wi-Fi is available for all students. All classrooms have AC facilities. There are lifts also available for ease of students. There is a big library for students, and there is also a seating arrangement for self-study.

reviews.review_heading: The best affordable college in Jalandhar.
reviews.review_text: If you talk about the infrastructure of our college, the air conditioning is available in only computer labs, but in classes there are only ceiling fans. Although the infrastructure is not good, if we keep in mind the fee structure of the courses, then according to that fee structure, the infrastructure is not to bad; there are all the necessary facilities available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Very highly qualified and knowledgeable teachers.
reviews.review_text: College has a beautiful infrastructure because it is not too old. The campus of the college is lush with greenery. The labs of the college have all the instruments required for the experiments. The library has all kinds of books. Classrooms were big and furnished. The college has a sports complex for sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: All the faculty members are highly qualified in their respective fields.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are not very good, the cleaning of the rooms is not proper and the hostel food quality is also not that good, they improve the quality of food if anyone complain to the authorities for few days and after that, the same quality is served. There are many restrictions for girls like they can only go home twice a month, they can not come out of the hostel after 6pm.

reviews.review_heading: Review of DAV University.
reviews.review_text: The facilities were very good. All facilities were available. Our campus was Wi-Fi enabled. Electricity facility was available 24X7. Water supply facility was provided in this college. Research laboratories, biology laboratories, and computer laboratories were available. There was a well-stocked library in this college. Our campus was huge.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend joining this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are very good. The food served in the mess is very good. It provides many other dishes at fests. Wi-Fi is provided in hostels. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled. There are many canteens in our college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good environment.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is good but there is a major issue of food. Food quality is not good. I am not a hosteler but my friends who lives in hostel tells about it. If you are taking admission in hostel then keep it in mind that there is no good food and also hostel fees is not value for money.

individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the campus life and academic curriculum.
